name: <a short run name in kebab-case, valid as a file name: goes into results and logs>
title: <one line: what this run is>
context: <one or two sentences for the header of every prompt: the genre of the places, how home entries are read, where the owner decisions live, the run's special rules; without this field the header is shorter>
home: <the default home entry, when one home serves all places; otherwise remove the field>

sources.name: <HOW TO NAME THE SOURCE IN THE PROMPT>
sources.hint: <how to read: search by grep, what is outdated, what outweighs>

canon: <path from the root to the owner decisions file; no such file — remove the field>
designDocs: <path from the root to the project's screen docs; no such docs — remove the field>
checksDir: <path from the root to your own deep-review/checks directory; usually remove the field — then the checks of the deep-review skill lying next to the team skill are used>
notFindings: <a «what is not a finding» line of this run: owner decisions, home entries already opened>
